Track the latest real turn context separately from the model-visible reference baseline, preserve compaction semantics during reverse replay, and update the affected core tests to seed the tracker through TurnContextItem.

head_commit.message:
core: unify reconstructed rollback turn context state

Track the latest surviving reconstructed turn context as a record with
the historical TurnContextItem and a compaction-cleared flag, then
derive previous_turn_settings, reference_context_item, and the rollback
event payload from that single state. This keeps rollback and resume
metadata aligned when the newest surviving user turn has no persisted
TurnContextItem but an older surviving turn does.

Co-authored-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>
